comment: Independent mhitu.c recipe: a female Knight in debug mode wears wished levitation boots, wishes a trap door under herself and creates a hostile incubus. doseduce() asks to remove her mail (n) and boots (y); losing levitation drops her through the trap door, which schedules a level change, so mayberem() returns early for her gloves, shield and helmet (mhitu.c 2319-2320) and doseduce() returns before the encounter (2136-2137).
